recapture_reason: Issue #1733 was re-described (title/description must be reused exactly, minus the parts --development-log and --deep-analysis provide; the solve chain gained --development-log --deep-analysis) and web-capture#139 was re-titled. PR #1929 review widened the scope to the whole repository, then clarified that the retired case-study paragraph must never exist in generated prompts because --development-log is its sole replacement.

template_issue.title: web-capture#139 — Check for all false positives, false negatives, warnings and errors in CI/CD and fix them all
template_issue.used_for: Source of the title (CI_CD_ISSUE_TITLE, pinned verbatim by a test) and of the standard remediation prompt reproduced by buildStandardPrompt(); its retired case-study paragraph is intentionally excluded because --development-log is the only supported replacement, while supported conditional paragraphs carry providedBy tags.
